content:
Incident Bot: HIGH PRIORITY: Elevated error rates observed for customer-notifications: outbound email errors to SendGrid (18% error rate) and SMS errors to Twilio (35% error rate). Affected services: /v1/notify/email, /v1/notify/sms. Paging current on-call: @Ravi K.

Ravi K: Oncall ack. Pulling logs & checking routing. Will validate whether this is vendor-side or our egress. @Maya P can you check provider health and routing policy (eu/na)?

Maya P: I see increased 502/5xx from SendGrid and 429 rate-limit responses from Twilio EU cluster. Correlates with vendor status pages: https://status.sendgrid.com (partial API degradation) and https://status.twilio.com (Messaging - elevated errors EU).

Sam R: Confirmed from app logs: our retries are spiking, queued messages increasing. Verification flow (SMS OTP) failing for ~22% of attempts in EU. Impact: signup & 2FA attempts delayed/failing.

Elaine S: Support is getting several escalations about verification codes not arriving. We need a customer-facing status update and a mitigation plan.

Ravi K: Quick mitigation proposals: 1) Enable email fallback provider for transactional emails (SES/mailgun) 2) Flip SMS routing to backup provider (MessageBird/Nexmo) for EU region 3) Temporarily relax strict verification timeout to allow retry window 4) Start background retries with dedup window to avoid duplicate codes. Which are low-risk to do now?

Maya P: We have an infra toggle for provider failover. Low-risk: flip email to SES for transactions. SMS is trickier (telco regs) but we can route new sends to MessageBird for EU using the routing policy override. I'll prepare the commands.

Sam R: I can flip the email provider now. Running CLI to change transactional provider:

```bash
# switch transactional email provider (rolls over within 30s)
redwoodctl config set notify.email.provider transactional ses --env=prod --region=eu
redwoodctl deploy-config --service=notify --env=prod
```

Maya P: For SMS routing override (EU -> MessageBird):

```bash
# add temporary routing rule at runtime
redwoodctl routing add --service=notify.sms --match-region=eu --provider=messagebird --priority=100 --ttl=2h
```

Ravi K: Executed email switch (SES). Observability: email error rate dropped from 18% -> 2% within 3m. Good. Proceeding to SMS routing override.

Sam R: Deployed SMS routing override. Twilio errors for EU reduced for new requests. Backfill still pending for queued jobs.

Support Bot: NOTE: Banner draft ready: "We're investigating delivery issues impacting email & SMS verification in EU. Some customers may see delayed or failed OTPs. We're working on mitigation." Elaine, please publish when ready.

Elaine S: Published banner and updated status page with vendor links and our mitigation steps. Slack incident channel created and post linked in customer status.

Jonah L: Support triage: Mark high-risk accounts (finance, enterprise) and offer manual verification workarounds where necessary. Creating a follow-up ticket template for affected customers.

Maya P: Vendor update: Twilio reports a regional rate-limiting issue that they are mitigating. SendGrid indicates intermittent API timeouts. They haven't provided ETA but say they are "working on it." We should keep fallback for at least 2 hours and monitor for delivery complaints.

Ravi K: Handoff plan: I'm stepping off active page in 40m. @Maya P can you be primary for remediation & vendor comms for the next shift? I'll leave runbook notes.

Maya P: Taking over. Runbook notes added: check queues, monitor delivery rates, watch for duplicate OTP deliveries (dedupe window set to 10m).

Sam R: Observability note: token-level breakdown shows most failures were 429s (Twilio) and 502s (SendGrid). Added an alert rule to fire if queuing backlog > 3k or verification success < 85% (for >5m).

Incident Bot: UPDATE: Twilio status changed to "degraded". SendGrid still "partial outage".

Jonah L: Logged customer-impact spreadsheet entry with sample customers and timestamps. Support has sent manual verification options to 7 paying customers so far.

Maya P: At 12:40 UTC vendors report mitigations in place. We're seeing retries start to succeed. However, some queued messages were dropped by vendor and needed replay. Requeued ~1.2k failed messages to SES/MessageBird.

Sam R: Requeue script used:

```python
# requeue failed deliveries (safe idempotent)
for msg in failed_messages:
    if not was_delivered(msg):
        enqueue(msg, provider=backup_for(msg.region))
```

Ravi K: Final check: delivery rates back to baseline (email <1% errors, SMS ~2%). Verification success normalized. Closing active paging.

Elaine S: Support: Sent final customer updates and apologies. Offering credits to 3 enterprise tenants hit hardest.

Maya P: Post-incident actions (P0): 1) Add automatic regional failover for SMS with lower latency trigger 2) Add canary tests for vendor capacity each morning 3) Update runbook to include immediate routing override steps + a one-click dashboard action 4) Run tabletop DR for notification provider outage.

Sam R: Moving follow-ups to #incidents-postmortems. Will prepare a short postmortem with timeline, impact metrics, and RCA on escalating vendor rate-limit behavior.

Incident Bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Root cause attributed to vendor-side rate limiting and API instability. Postmortem required.

Maya P: Thanks team. Leaving final note: if anyone sees any lingering delivery anomalies, ping me directly.
